services.desc: “Dog Days of Summer” invites social dogs and their humans (or humans who love dogs!) to come together for an evening of crafts, acoustic music, treats, and community! Note: Please expect that many dogs will be present on this evening. Dogs must be kept on a leash and attended to by their human at all times. Every second Friday of the month through October, the Torpedo Factory Art Center is open late. Meet artists, experience special activations, and immerse yourself in the vibrant arts community.
